name: vwap_band_reversion_5s
author: adapted from claude_strategist
thesis: VWAP ± 1 and 2 standard deviation bands act as institutional support/resistance. When price touches the 2nd SD band and reverses, it reliably returns to at least the 1st SD band. This inefficiency exists because institutional TWAP/VWAP algos create natural absorption at these levels, but the exact timing of absorption is uncertain, causing temporary overshoots. The edge is in combining the band touch with a volume surge confirmation that signals institutional absorption is occurring.
mechanism: Short-term selling exhausts available demand at a price level, creating a temporary liquidity vacuum. Market makers who absorbed the selling begin marking prices back to reduce inventory risk. Limit buy orders resting below create a floor, and new participants entering the long side accelerate the reversion as the forced selling pressure dissipates.
weaknesses: VWAP SD bands early in the day (first 30 min) are unstable — insufficient data for reliable SD calc
In strong trend days, price can blow through 2SD and never revert — need robust stop
Volume spike filter is noisy early morning; opening volume naturally spikes
prior_art: VWAP band trading — institutional desk strategy adapted for systematic execution
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
